title: Recognition Object
description: Frozen recognition-carrier derived directly from acts. Objects are immutable and only loaded at boot.

id.description: Stable identifier for the object within the persistent layer.

kind.description: Recognition kind (e.g., ProfileTopos, PhaseSpace, MeasurementFrame, Trace, FixedInvariant, ObservationCarrier).

acts.description: Act-level recognitions that generate this carrier.

payload.description: Finite recognition lattice fragment and contextual data carried by this object.

metadata.description: Auxiliary information such as provenance or diagnostics seeded by acts.
